main_text.p: mine mirum eft,quantum Schifmatici venerentur, dum per eam & auctoritas Pontificia vulneretur, & sui Photij partes subleuentur, & additio in Symbolo, siue mauis proceffio ex Filio conuellatur. Sunt ergo Synodi coactæ a Photio, Prima post expulsum Ignatium ad reconciliandos sibi animos Præsulum: Secunda, qua præsidentibus Legatis Pontificijs Rodoaldo & Zacharia, Ignatius damnatur exauctoraturq; quæ a Nicolao Pontifice Latrocinalis appellatur: Tertia & quarta, quas ille post fui in Romano Concilio condemnationem coëgit, siue potius confinxit alteram aduersus Romanam Sedem, alteram aduersus Ignatium: Quinta post necem Bardæ, sub Michaële tamen, in qua aduersus Romanum Pontificem Nicolaum anathematis sententiam protulit: Sexta post obitum Ignatij, & sui cum Basilio reconciliationem, qua in Throno Constantinopolitano, Ioannis Pontificis, cuius & multas laudes profequitur, literis, falsatis tamen, confirmatur, & in qua impudentissime suam auctoritatem etiam in Romanam iurisdictionem extendit, tantum non sibi Pontificem obnoxium faciens, & afferentes processionem ex Filio Spiritus condemnat ita, vt additio illa futuris etiam temporibus interdicatur.

page.notes: The page number is printed as "8" with a small mark after it ("8°"); only the number is recorded. The word "fui" (for "sui" sense, as printed) is a doubtful reading of the scan and is left as printed. The text is set in a single column, with no running head and no signature visible. The scan has stains and marks in the margins and at the foot, which were not transcribed.
